name: Hot & Sour Veg Cup a Soup
ingredients_raw: Potato Starch, Maltodextrin, Dehydrated Vegetables (Onion (4.5%), Carrot Flakes (2.7%), Garlic Bits (2.2%) and Leeks (0.4%)), Sugar, lodised Salt, Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein, Nature Identical Flavouring Substances (Soya Sauce), Thickener - 415, Spices & Condiments (Chillies (1.5%)), Hydrogenated Palm Oil, Food Colour-Caramel IV, Acidity Regulator-296, Anti caking agent - 551, Flavour Enhancer-627 & 631, Oleoresin Chilli.
